description: Pinned inputs of the ai-framegen-upscale export: upstream code (imported only from the verified copies in <work>/sources), model weights (terms recorded separately from code) and the corpus panoramas. fetch.py verifies and imports these; it never downloads. Hashes are sha256 of the file bytes; gitBlob is git's object id of the file at the pinned commit.
recorded: 2026-10-13, from the research-phase copies in build/ai-framegen-upscale/{upstream,weights} (retrieved 2026-10-12/13) and the corpus census build/ai-framegen-upscale/probes/replay/census_youvisit_backup.json

rt4ksr-x2.retrieval: The file is in the RT4KSR repository at code/checkpoints/rt4ksr_x2.pth (commit fd6627a48d789adf5d9aad29f02ab2a3d2a25296); clone it as described in code.rt4ksr.retrieval, or save that file as <import-root>/weights/rt4ksr/rt4ksr_x2.pth; then run fetch.py --import-from=<import-root>.

corpusSource.description: The spherical-image-representation benchmark corpus (scripts/benchmarks/spherical-image-representation/lib/source.mjs CORPUS): six UMN tour panoramas as served by YouVisit, 6144x3072 equirectangular baseline JPEG, 4:2:0, no ICC profile.
corpusSource.snapshot: UMN-VR YouVisit backup snapshot-2026-09-27 (media/panoramas/<panorama>/6144.jpg; manifest.json lists URL, bytes, sha256, Last-Modified)
corpusSource.rights: Follows the spherical benchmark's rules: the source images are read from the given root and never copied into the repository; derived images (crops, renders) stay in build/; only numbers and hashes are committed.
corpusSource.census: build/ai-framegen-upscale/probes/replay/census_youvisit_backup.json (research phase): all six hashes match the benchmark's
